crawl: Chrome live crawl, same-origin fetch, cache: no-store, sequential per URL, on 2026-11-13 Vietnam time (one day after the 12 Nov crawl).
method: TTFB measured with performance.now() around a sequential fetch of each URL with a 15 s abort. Words counted on a body clone with script/style/noscript/template removed. Schema blocks counted as application/ld+json elements, @type walked through @graph. Internal links are unique same-origin paths per page. MISSING-ALT RULE (in force since 2 Oct 2026): only visible outside
score_rationale: Health 97 -> 97 (raw 96.9 -> 96.9; weights .25/.25/.20/.15/.15). Measured against 12 Nov. No sub-score moves: same 121 pages all 200, 0 orphans, FAQPage 98/98, 1,306 images all with alt, 119 of 121 pages with JSON-LD, corpus 255,267 words unchanged. TTFB mean 220.0 -> 240.6 ms and the ceiling 475 -> 615 ms (/articles/3d-rendering-company-melbourne) are within normal run-to-run variation and every page is still under 1 s, so Performance holds at 99.
